notes.title: 1.1 upgrade arrived
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Fixed: Levels 31, 40, 41 and 47 were repaired.
    [*]Changed: The receivers' rotation system now it works keeping left click and dragging the mouse to send the color ray to another receiver.
    [*]Removed: The timer's sounds were eliminated.
[/list]

Have fun! n_n

Att. The Sliverbroom Studios' development team.

notes.title: Upcoming update.
notes.content:
We are making an update of the game. 

[list]
    [*]We are resolving some issues, including an error in the level 31 that it makes it impossible to solve
    [*]Changing the receivers' rotation system: Now with left click, you will be able to select a receiver and its beam will follow the mouse.
    [*]The timer's sounds will be eliminated.
[/list]

The update will be available the next weekend.

Att. The Sliverbroom Studios' development team.
